answer_1.quote: The Text Style transfer (TST) task is a form of controlled language generation.

answer_2.quote: Evaluation for text style transfer includes checking for a) Style Transfer accuracy, b) Content preservation metrics and c) Fluency of output sentences. ... Apart from the standard of using BLEU between sentences of source and target styles, we borrow evaluation techniques ... such as METEOR, ROUGE-L ... Embedding Average, Vector Extrema and Greedy matching score. ... We follow this metric during our evaluation of fluency or naturalness §

answer_4.quote: Each human annotator was given a set of base sentences and asked to vote for which model produced the most appropriate corresponding style inverted sentences.
answer_4.guideline: The evaluation guidelines was formulated to consider which model a) successfully transferred the target style b) preserved the style-independent content and c) was overall fluent and grammatically coherent.
